name: Vic.ai
tagline: Vic.ai is an AI accounting platform that automates accounts payable processing from invoice capture to payment approval. Its deep-learning models handle GL coding, approval routing, and anomaly detection, eliminating manual data entry and reducing invoice processing costs.
